name: Context Menu
description: Floating right-click context menu singleton. Renders a positioned menu at cursor coordinates with items (label + action callback) and optional separators and disabled state. Closes on any click outside the menu. Supports chaining via menu array with separator: true support. Only one context menu can be open at a time — previous menu is closed on new creation.

properties.name: onClose
properties.description: Callback invoked when menu is closed

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Creates positioned menu with items, closes any existing context menu

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the menu DOM element and triggers onClose

lifecycle.created_by: Right-click event handler in FileExplorerPlugin, MonacoEditorPlugin, MarkdownPlugin, or CanvasArea
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Click outside menu, or explicit remove() call
